title: Integral closure commutes with etale base change
statement: Let $R,B,T$ be commutative rings with ring maps $R\to B$ and $R\to T$. Assume $T$ is an etale $R$-algebra: the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}T\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ induced by $R\to T$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $C\subseteq B$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Give tensor products the algebra multiplication $(t\otimes b)(t^{\prime}\otimes b^{\prime})=tt^{\prime}\otimes bb^{\prime}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then the canonical $T$-algebra map $q_T:T\otimes_R C\to\overline{T}^{\,T\otimes_R B}$, $t\otimes c\mapsto t\otimes c$, to the integral closure of $T$ in $T\otimes_R B$ is an isomorphism. No injectivity or nonzero-ring hypothesis is imposed.
